intro: Inilauncher now shows what's new after each update, and you can back up and share your setup. Here's what arrived in the last few versions.

features.title: Back up and share your setup
features.text: Settings → Extras → Backup & sharing: save your look and settings to a file, share it, or import one. You see every change first and can undo it.

features.title: Search settings
features.text: Type in the box at the top of Settings to find any setting, on Settings or Extras. Tap a result to jump straight to it.

features.title: Free placement in the sub list
features.text: Long-press ⋯ and turn on Free placement: drop apps in any spot, leave gaps, or drop one app on another to swap them.

features.title: Check for updates
features.text: At the bottom of Settings. New versions also show a card on the home screen. Tap Update and it installs itself.
